India drops out of top 4 in WTC 2025-27 standings

Following the conclusion of the second Test between Sri Lanka and West Indies, India has fallen out of the top four in the World Test Championship 2025-27 points table. Pakistan is currently at the bottom of the standings. West Indies secured their first Test series win against Sri Lanka in 23 years.
